en: Having prostrated with my head before the Sage with a most serene mind, I shall today proclaim the names [of the Noble Mañjuśrī] as they have been extolled by the Perfectly Awakened Ones. (1)
Possessing a beautiful form and assuming all forms, he is indeed the unsurpassed one who embodies every form; Mañjuśrī is supreme in glory, being perfectly endowed with all the marks of excellence.
Inconceivable, free from the conceivable, inconceivable, and possessing wondrous prowess;
he is inconceivable among all phenomena and likewise inconceivable to the mind. (3)
You are one whose self is cultivated in emptiness, endowed with empty phenomena;
you are empty, as is your resolute conviction, and you are the teacher of the three realms of existence as empty. || 4 ||
He is the omniscient one and the all-seeing, the sovereign lord of all stages, the pervasive one;
he is Mañjuśrī, the wielder of power, the lotus-eyed one, and the one born from the lotus.
He has the color of the filaments of a lotus, sits upon a lotus throne,
holds a blue lotus, is pure, holy, and possesses a tranquil mind.
You are called the Pratyekabuddha, the Buddha, and the Ādibuddha;
you possess miraculous powers, have attained mastery, and are the teacher of the Four Truths. || 7 ||
You are the world-protector, the thousand-eyed one, the Lord, and the progenitor of beings; you are Śiva to all creatures, the pervasive sovereign, and an ocean of virtues.
You are a holy rishi, most excellent and eldest, as well as one who remembers his past lives;
you are Vināyaka, the Guide, the Son of the Jina, and the Offspring of the Jina.
You are Bhānu, the possessor of a thousand rays; you are Soma and you are Bṛhaspati.
You are Dhanada and Varuṇa; you are Viṣṇu and you are Maheśvara.
You are Ananta, the king of serpents, and likewise Skanda the commander of the army;
you are Vemacitra, the lord of the Asuras, as well as Bhauma, Śukra, and Budha.
The hero consists of all the gods and is saluted by all the gods;
you have transcended the impurities of worldly dharmas and are the foremost person in the world.
He knows the world, is renowned throughout the world, and is the most excellent among the wise;
he is the bestower of boons, a refuge, a protection, and is invincible to those who act as Māras.
Profound and irreproachable are the perfections of your spiritual friends;
you are a physician, a remover of thorns, a tamer of men, and a skilled charioteer. (14)
He is wise, possessed of movement, intelligent, and discerning; he is meritorious, a wish-fulfilling tree, and adorned with the flowers of the factors of enlightenment. || 15 ||
The body of all embodied beings is perfected with the fruit of liberation;
it is captivating, pleasing, and faultless for those who lead the holy life. 16.
You are Ketu, the best of the planets, and the preeminent sage among sages;
you have been consecrated as the crown prince, the lord and master of the ten stages (bhūmis).
You are the caravan leader, the foremost of the assembly, the teacher of supreme Nirvāṇa;
you are like space, you are the intermediate kalpa, and you are both fire and wind.
You are the wish-fulfilling gem for sentient beings, the fulfiller of all hopes;
homage be to you, O Great Knowledge, who are worshipped by all beings. 19.
The hymn of one hundred and eight names of the glorious noble Mañjuśrī is completed.
